Package dev.relism.flash.ext.security.basic

Class BasicAuth

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.security.basic.BasicAuth
All Implemented Interfaces:
AuthenticationMechanism, Module
public final class BasicAuth extends Object implements Module, AuthenticationMechanism
HTTP Basic (RFC 7617): a user name and password with every request, checked against the same PasswordStore and PasswordEncoder as form sign-in. Meant for clients that cannot sign in any other way, such as an operating system mounting a WebDAV share; use it over TLS only. 

 app.install(new SecurityModule(), new BasicAuth(accounts::byUsername));

A password hash costs a lot on purpose, and a Basic client sends the password every time, so a verified pair is remembered for cacheFor(java.time.Duration) (5 minutes) by its SHA-256, up to cacheSize (10,000) pairs. A wrong password is never remembered; a changed one takes effect when its entry expires.
